title: Kissed Indulgent Polish Yautia Bake
description: A rich Polish dish featuring yautia topped with a sweet glaze, perfect for a special evening dinner.
instructions: Peel and dice the yautia, and set aside.
In a large bowl, cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add the flour and mix until just combined.
Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
Stir in the yogurt and mix until smooth.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Transfer the mixture to a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until lightly golden brown.
While the bake is baking, prepare the glaze by whisking together the confectioners sugar and lemon juice.
Remove the bake from the oven and top with the glaze.
Return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes, or until the glaze is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
